review_input.original_instruction: Turn away opposite the toilet and face the T.V. and fireplace. Take one step towards the fireplace. Turn to the left and you will see an open door, walk through the open door. Keep walking straight onto the hardwood floor. Facing straight down the hardwood floor hallway, take a left and go up the stairs. Continue up the stairs all the way to the top. At the top you'll see a couch with an American flag on it, walk towards the couch and stay just to the right of the lamp. Turn right and you will see a fireplace with an American flag on the left hand side. Head down that left hand side staying to the left of the American flag, but to the right of the chair. Walk just past the American flag and stand next to the clock on your left. You've reached your final destination.
